A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the magnetic nanoparticles (MNP) were coated with a mesoporous silica (MS) shell, which was subsequently modified by a [2 +4] Diels-Alder cycloaddition reaction with the diene and the dienophile.
we have developed a novel thermoresponsive nanocapsule that is triggered by alternating magnetic fields.
we have developed an externally triggered drug delivery system that can be used for the release of a wide range of drugs.

the combination of a superparamagnetic core with the mesoporous silica matrix allows the use of the superparamagnetic heating effect for externally triggered cargo release.
